chunks: He said: "O Lord, I fear that they will deny me."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say when he feared his people would deny his message?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) voices his fear of rejection by his people, a sentiment shared by other prophets to emphasize their reliance on divine support rather than personal eloquence. This highlights the human element of prophetic communication and the psychological burden of delivering a message often met with denial. The verse underscores the theme of steadfastness in the face of adversity, a key motif in the narratives of the prophets.
